''See also: [[earth aura Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Earth [[aura]] is a form of energy found within the ground and [[stone]]. When viewed through [[Copper sight]], it appears as golden lightning or glowing yellow cubes within rocks. This energy is highly concentrated in stones; over centuries, an ordinary rock can absorb enough power to transform into nearly unbreakable [[Titan’s Bone]]. Earth artists utilize this [[aura]] and [[madra]] to manipulate the environment, such as by opening passages in [[stone]]. In certain locations, earth [[aura]] can be found in veins within the ground, which [[sacred artists]] may harvest to advance their power. The intensity of this energy can vary significantly; it can manifest as a low thrumming or pulsing rhythm in the earth, and extreme concentrations can cause the ground to shake, mountains to buzz, or even stain the sky gold. In some instances, earth [[aura]] can become so powerful that it bleeds into visibility to the naked eye or causes nearby trees to petrify.}}

== Bloodline ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|The earth [[aura]] manifests as a force that can surge beneath one's feet, as seen when [[Orthos]] stands upon it. These veins of energy pulse with the intensity of lightning, prompting consultation from the [[Eighth Elder]]. Near [[Mount Venture]], the [[aura]] grows bright enough to shake the ground, and it can be gathered by a hammer or even frozen. This power eventually flashes out in a golden wave and possesses the strength to pull [[Lindon]] down from his skin.}}
